plan.doc_literal_usage: Access each metadata dunder name advertised in attrs.__all__ directly on the attrs package.
plan.argument_finding_is_false: The citation only shows that these names appear in __all__; it does not itself promise that every __all__ entry is importable by normal attribute access, and __doc__ is genuinely available as a module attribute. Still, __all__ is conventionally treated as the public API inventory, so most of the listed names are unusable.
